notes: Two branches joined by «ح»; «كلاهما عن شعبة، عن حصين، بهذا الإسناد» is written once, so it is the shared tail of both.
«- يعني ابن جعفر -» is an editor gloss and is left out; the second branch's «محمد» is the third standalone «محمد» in the text.
«وابن، بشار» has its و removed; the name is copied as written with the comma.
«غير أن في حديث محمد بن جعفر ...» is a wording variant and is not a route.
